description: ShareAndRelate - One person shares about {topic}, others relate with similar experiences

actions.action_goal: {"id": "share_and_relate_{topic_id}", "description": "Have one person share about {topic}, then invite others to relate with similar experiences.", "success_criteria": [{"id": "c1", "description": "{robot_name} asks who wants to share about {topic}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c2", "description": "One participant shares their experience or story.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c3", "description": "{robot_name} asks if anyone else has had a similar experience.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c4", "description": "{robot_name} keeps participants engaged for {discussion_time}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}], "timeout": {"max_time": {"minutes": 5, "seconds": 0}, "max_turns": null}, "additional_instructions": ["Address the group as a whole.", "React to what participants say, encourage others to relate, and keep responses short."]}

topic.description: What to share about (e.g., 'a funny memory', 'a challenge you overcame', 'something you learned recently')

discussion_time.description: How long to continue the discussion (e.g., '2 minutes', '90 seconds')
